content:
# One distribution for every Python tool. The folders stay where they are; the wheel maps them in.
# spanish-poller (Node) and ocr-bench (a hand-run benchmark) are not part of it.
[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling>=1.24", "hatch-vcs>=0.4"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[project]
name = "gramps-web-toolkit"
dynamic = ["version"]
description = "Command-line tools for running AI research agents against a Gramps Web family tree without letting them write guesses into it"
readme = "README.md"
license = "GPL-3.0-or-later"
license-files = ["LICENSE"]
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = ["requests>=2.28"]
keywords = ["genealogy", "gramps", "gramps-web", "family-tree", "ai-agents"]
classifiers = [
    "Environment :: Console",
    "Operating System :: POSIX",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3 :: Only",
    "Topic :: Sociology :: Genealogy",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
mh = ["playwright>=1.40"]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/GeiserX/gramps-web-toolkit"
Documentation = "https://geiserx.github.io/gramps-web-toolkit/"
Issues = "https://github.com/GeiserX/gramps-web-toolkit/issues"

[project.scripts]
gwt = "gwt_core.cli:main"
gwt-apply = "gwt_apply.cli:main"
gwt-check = "gwt_check.cli:main"
gwt-fetch = "gwt_fetch.cli:main"
gwt-ledger = "gwt_ledger:main"
gwt-gate = "gwt_gate:main"
gwt-fscache = "gwt_fscache:main"
gwt-queue = "gwt_queue:main"
gwt-leads = "gwt_leads:main"
gwt-rank = "gwt_rank:main"
gwt-import-excel = "gwt_import_excel:main"
gwt-rawstore = "gwt_rawstore:main"
gwt-mh = "gwt_core.cli:mh"
gwt-read = "gwt_read:main"

# The version comes from the git tag: `v0.2.0` builds 0.2.0; a commit after it builds 0.2.1.devN+g<sha>.
[tool.hatch.version]
source = "vcs"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["apply/gwt_apply", "check/gwt_check", "fetch/gwt_fetch", "core/gwt_core"]
# `pip install -e .` puts these folders on sys.path instead of copying files
dev-mode-dirs = ["apply", "check", "fetch", "core", "ledger", "gate", "fscache", "queue", "leads", "rank",
                 "importxl", "rawstore", "myheritage", "read"]

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel.force-include]
"ledger/gwt_ledger.py" = "gwt_ledger.py"
"gate/gwt_gate.py" = "gwt_gate.py"
"fscache/gwt_fscache.py" = "gwt_fscache.py"
"queue/gwt_queue.py" = "gwt_queue.py"
"leads/gwt_leads.py" = "gwt_leads.py"
"rank/gwt_rank.py" = "gwt_rank.py"
"importxl/gwt_import_excel.py" = "gwt_import_excel.py"
"rawstore/gwt_rawstore.py" = "gwt_rawstore.py"
"myheritage/gwt_mh.py" = "gwt_mh.py"
"myheritage/gwt_mh_browser.py" = "gwt_mh_browser.py"
"myheritage/gwt-mh" = "gwt_mh_cli.py"
"read/gwt_reader.py" = "gwt_reader.py"
"read/gwt_read.py" = "gwt_read.py"
"read/gwt_pares.py" = "gwt_pares.py"
"read/gwt_genae.py" = "gwt_genae.py"
"read/gwt_boe.py" = "gwt_boe.py"
